key_claims_and_derivations.claim: Mean lifetime tau is 1/lambda_tot; half-life T_1/2 = tau ln 2; resonance energy width Gamma_tot = hbar * lambda_tot. If given Gamma_tot, it must first be divided by hbar before entering rate equations. In rate formulas where the dimensioned constant already incorporates hbar and permittivity, neither hbar nor ln 2 may be multiplied again.
key_claims_and_derivations.locator: Suhonen 2007, printed p. 118, Eq. (6.1); thesis Section 5.9.1

key_claims_and_derivations.claim: Total transition rate is lambda_k = lambda_gamma,k * (1 + alpha_k), where alpha_k is total internal conversion coefficient. Total branching ratio b_k = lambda_k / lambda_tot yields lambda_gamma,k = b_k / [tau * (1 + alpha_k)]. Normalization using relative photon intensities a_k requires complete decay channels with zero unobserved E0 conversion or particle emission.

Real multipole mixing ratio delta(E2/M1) is the ratio of photon emission probability amplitudes. Photon fractions are delta²/(1+delta²) for E2 and 1/(1+delta²) for M1. The effective ICC alpha_mix must be weighted by the same photon fractions. Phase convention changes affect sign of delta and angular distribution F_k coefficients, but never delta² or transition rates.
key_claims_and_derivations.locator: Lange, Kumar & Hamilton 1982, printed pp. 121–122, Eqs. (2.1)–(2.6); thesis Section 5.9.3

key_claims_and_derivations.claim: Downwards B(XL; i->f) = |<f||M(XL)||i>|² / (2Ii+1); reciprocal relation (2Ii+1)B(i->f) = (2If+1)B(f->i). Reconstructed rounded Suhonen constant C_E2 ~ 1.2250e9 s^-1 MeV^-5 (e² fm⁴)^-1 from printed rounded constants. Gaussian C_M1 ~ 1.758e13 s^-1 MeV^-3 mu_N^-2 declared; Suhonen SI unit [(mu_N/c)²] noted.
key_claims_and_derivations.locator: Suhonen 2007, printed pp. 118–120, Eqs. (6.3), (6.4), (6.12)–(6.14); thesis Section 5.9.4

key_claims_and_derivations.claim: In branching ratios from the same parent state, the mean lifetime tau algebraically cancels out. However, mixing ratio uncertainties, ICC model errors, detector efficiency curve slopes, and negative covariance from peak fitting remain. Across different parent states, lifetime and stopping-power uncertainties do not cancel. Local linear propagation J V J^T fails when multimodality or physical boundaries exist.

Görgen et al. (2004) DSAM measurement in 163Lu provided valuable new lifetimes, but interband absolute B(E2) and B(M1) strengths strictly relied on thin-target branching ratios (Jensen 2002) and an adopted low-spin average mixing ratio delta = -3.10. Similar Qt or strong interband B(E2) is a necessary condition for wobbling, but not a sufficient proof against quasiparticle-alignment or gamma-soft competing mechanisms.
key_claims_and_derivations.locator: Görgen et al. 2004, PDF pp. 2–4, Tables I–II; thesis Section 5.9.7
